body: techmeme.com: Scott Aaronson / Shtetl-Optimized : Sources: leading AI labs are sitting on major, unreleased algorithmic breakthroughs that could break deployed cryptosystems, but their exact nature is unknown I feel like my previous posts (and post titles), and podcasts, and talks, have failed to do full justice to the magnitude of what's now happening, so I'm trying again.

simonwillison.net: It’s now obvious that we’ll be getting, not one-off solutions to this or that complexity question, but a whole new continent of mathematical truth, one that we’d previously only glimpsed through fog. Picture van Leeuwenhoek first training a microscope on pondwater, or Galileo first training his telescope on the stars. That might give you some idea of how our resolution into the complexity-theoretic universe, and the whole universe of mathematical truth beyond it, has now improved. Scott Aaronson Tags: mathematics , llms , ai , generative-ai
